item.title: TrueNAS Cron Jobs Worth Setting Up on Every Home Server
item.author: team@silocitylabs.com (Silo City Labs)
item.description: A home server is great until you have to keep logging in to do the same maintenance tasks over and over. I’ve been running TrueNAS SCALE for a while, and a few simple cron jobs have saved me from having to babysit some of my services. These are three jobs I actually use: one to keep my domain pointed at my home IP address, one to redeploy my Palworld server each morning, and one to pull updated Plex images monthly.
